# Science Mom

> Secular homeschool science courses for grades 4–8, made by Science Mom (Jenny Ballif) and Math Dad (Serge Ballif), a family team in Southeast Alaska. Courses are video-based with follow-along notes and hands-on projects. One price covers every student in a household.

## Who we are

- Science Mom (Jenny Ballif): molecular biologist and wildland firefighter. B.S. in crop science and M.S. in plant science, Utah State University.
- Math Dad (Serge Ballif): mathematician and math teacher. Ph.D. in mathematics, Penn State University.
- We started doing volunteer science demonstrations in 2013 and began making courses together as Science Mom & Math Dad in 2020.

## Science courses

All science courses are secular and include video lessons, follow-along notes, comprehension checks, and hands-on projects. Individual courses are $150 per family (payment plan: 4 payments of $37.50).

## For schools

Charter schools and microschools can use Science Mom courses. Details: {{ site.courses_url }}/p/charterschools

## Scholarships and Patreon

- Scholarships are available for families who need help with course costs.
- Patreon ($10/month) supports a weekly online chess club and weekly Painting With a Scientist for kids ages 6–16, and includes $25 off every course. https://www.patreon.com/sciencemom

## Free resources

- 100+ science and math videos on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/sciencemom
- Step-by-step experiments with household materials: https://science.mom/experiments/
- Printable foldable mini-books, worksheets, and activity guides: https://science.mom/printables/
